capability: GHS Rev. 9 / EU CLP 1272/2008 public hazard prescreen for the 5 canonical DGEBA epoxy amine hardeners (IPDA, DDS, DETA, TETA, m-XDA). Every H-statement is a published harmonised (ECHA CLP Inventory Annex VI Table 3.1) or self-classified regulatory entry. Real portfolio finding: 4/5 candidates flag H314 (skin corrosion 1B); 5/5 universally flag chronic aquatic toxicity (H410/H411); 1 flags carcinogen (H351, DDS); 1 flags respiratory sensitiser (H334, m-XDA). Deterministic procurement gate outcomes: 3 require corrosive-PPE plan, 1 carcinogen monitoring, 1 respiratory-sensitiser containment. Grants no batch-release, manufacturing-qualification, or product-performance authority.

fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.gate_rule: if H350/H340/H360 present -> SVHC_REVIEW_REQUIRED (would-be SVHC candidate); elif H334 present -> RESPIRATORY_SENSITISER_CONTAINMENT_REQUIRED; elif H351 present -> CARCINOGEN_CAT_2_MONITORING_REQUIRED; elif H314 present -> CORROSIVE_PPE_PLAN_REQUIRED; else STANDARD_PROCUREMENT. All amines with H314 (skin corrosive 1B) are still PROCURABLE with documented PPE and containment plan — industry-standard practice for epoxy amine hardeners.

metrics.name: n_candidates_at_least_5
metrics.note: n_candidates = 5 canonical DGEBA epoxy amine hardeners (IPDA, DDS, DETA, TETA, m-XDA). Same set as Push #19/#31/#39 for portfolio consistency.

metrics.name: all_candidates_have_h_statements
metrics.note: Every candidate has at least one published H-statement from ECHA CLP Inventory or PubChem GHS. Per candidate: IPDA=6, DDS=5, DETA=5, TETA=5, m-XDA=7.

metrics.name: corrosive_H314_flagged_in_majority
metrics.note: H314 (Skin corrosion Cat 1B) present on 4/5 candidates. Consistent with published amine hardener chemistry (all cured epoxy amines are alkaline corrosive at industrial concentrations). DDS is the exception because it is aromatic-sulfone.

metrics.name: chronic_aquatic_toxicity_flagged_universally
metrics.note: All 5 candidates carry either H410 (very toxic aquatic, chronic 1) or H411 (toxic aquatic, chronic 2). Documents that aquatic-hazard management is a UNIVERSAL Phase-1 requirement across the DGEBA epoxy amine chemistry class — not a candidate-specific finding.

metrics.name: carcinogen_flag_documented
metrics.note: 1/5 candidates have a carcinogen H-statement (H351 suspected carcinogen category 2). Specifically: DDS (dapsone) — IARC Group 3, but CLP-classified H351 by industry self-classification. HONEST documentation: the coating portfolio must gate DDS through a carcinogen-monitoring plan before procurement.

metrics.name: respiratory_sensitiser_flag_documented
metrics.note: 1/5 candidates have H334 (respiratory sensitiser). Specifically: m-XDA (m-xylylenediamine). This triggers the RESPIRATORY_SENSITISER_CONTAINMENT_REQUIRED gate.

metrics.name: procurement_gates_produced_per_candidate
metrics.note: Every candidate (5/5) has a deterministic procurement gate outcome: CARCINOGEN_CAT_2_MONITORING_REQUIRED=1, CORROSIVE_PPE_PLAN_REQUIRED=3, RESPIRATORY_SENSITISER_CONTAINMENT_REQUIRED=1.

metrics.name: regulatory_sources_cited_per_candidate
metrics.note: Every candidate cites at least 2 public regulatory sources (ECHA CLP Inventory + PubChem GHS Classifications). No hazard statement is unsourced.

population: 5 canonical DGEBA epoxy amine hardeners (same portfolio set as Push #19/#31/#39): IPDA (isophoronediamine, CAS 2855-13-2), DDS (4,4'-diaminodiphenyl sulfone, CAS 80-08-0), DETA (diethylenetriamine, CAS 111-40-0), TETA (triethylenetetramine, CAS 112-24-3), m-XDA (m-xylylenediamine, CAS 1477-55-0).
split_methodology: NO train/test split — this is a regulatory prescreen driven by published harmonised classifications. Every H-statement is traceable to ECHA CLP Inventory or PubChem GHS Classifications. Deterministic gate rule applied per candidate; no learned parameters.
